hypotheses.reasoning: Up to 21:21 the worker processed batches normally. Then msg-195727 at offset 246773 made expandReferences overflow the stack, most likely because of self-referencing or cyclic references. The worker crashed, restarted from the same committed offset and crashed on the same message every time. That is the CrashLoopBackOff, and lag grows because nothing gets past that message. The version stays v4.5.8 across restarts and the logs show no deploy.
There is no sign of a new release. It would only matter if v4.5.8 was rolled out recently, which the logs don't show.

verdict.recommendedAction: Move msg-195727 (offset 246773) to a dead-letter queue or skip it so the consumer can catch up. Then add cycle detection and a depth limit to expandReferences, and catch errors per message so one bad message can't crash the worker.
